name: Peppermint Tea
siboNotes: Peppermint tea is well-tolerated and may actually help reduce SIBO symptoms due to its antimicrobial and antispasmodic properties. Avoid sweetening with high FODMAP ingredients.
preparationTips: Steep fresh peppermint leaves for 5-7 minutes for optimal flavor
Use 1-2 teaspoons dried peppermint per cup of boiling water
Avoid adding honey or high FODMAP sweeteners
Can be enjoyed hot or cold throughout the day
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in menthol with digestive benefits
May help reduce nausea and digestive discomfort
